_doc: clinic-listen — the page makes the person legible to the agent (2026-09-02).
At load there is no clinic_wait_for_request. The person types a request into the page (the
typed fallback; speech and signs feed the same queue): the tool is born, the agent's call
returns the person's words with via:typed, a second call with nothing said returns request:null
after the timeout, and 'stop' tells the agent to stop looping. Counts stay as other cases
expect (9 at load on the seeded board) because nothing listens until the person acts.
The person types to the page (a trusted keystroke path is not required for a request — it is content, not consent).
The agent asks: it gets the person's words, and is told to loop.

outputMatches: hold me the earliest appointment[\s\S]*via.{0,4}:.{0,3}typed[\s\S]*call clinic_wait_for_request again

matches: heard you: “hold me the earliest appointment”

_doc: Nothing pending, nothing said: the tool waits the asked second and answers honestly. The queue drained, so the tool dies.
